chunks: Gardens of Eden with gates open wide to them,

key_terms.جَنَّاتِ: Gardens (plural of Jannah, referring to Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Gardens of Eden with gates open wide' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'open gates' (al-abwab) symbolize the readiness of Divine grace to receive the faithful, reflecting the concept of *Tawassul* through the Ahl al-Bayt as intermediaries of entry. This imagery underscores the transition from the trials of the material world to the eternal serenity of *Jannat al-Khuld*, where the righteous are granted direct access to God's presence.
